items.source: By default aggregated information is logged every 30 minutes at INFO level. The frequency of logging can be changed via setLoggingPeriod(long).
items.translation: 默认情况下，聚合信息每 30 分钟以 INFO 级别记录。可以通过setLoggingPeriod(long)更改记录频率。

items.source: This class is declared as a Spring bean by the above configuration with the name "webSocketMessageBrokerStats" and can be easily exported to JMX, for example, with the MBeanExporter.
items.translation: 该类由上述配置声明为 Spring 圈，名称为 "webSocketMessageBrokerStats"，并且可以轻松导出到 JMX，例如使用 MBeanExporter。

items.source: By default this property is set to 30 minutes (30 * 60 * 1000).
items.translation: 默认情况下，此属性设置为 30 分钟（30 * 60 * 1000）。

items.source: Get stats about WebSocket sessions. Can return null if no WebSocket handler is configured.
items.translation: 获取 WebSocket 会话的统计信息。如果未配置WebSocket 处理器，则可能返回null。

items.source: Get stats about STOMP-related WebSocket message processing. Can return null if no SubProtocolHandler was found.
items.translation: 获取有关 STOMP 相关 WebSocket 消息处理的统计信息。如果未找到任何SubProtocolHandler，则可能返回null。

items.source: Get stats about STOMP broker relay (when using a full-featured STOMP broker). Can return null if no STOMP broker relay is configured.
items.translation: 获取 STOMP 代理中继的统计信息（在使用功能完整的 STOMP 代理时）。如果没有配置 STOMP 代理中继，则可能返回 null。

items.source: Get stats about the executor processing incoming messages from WebSocket clients.
items.translation: 获取有关处理来自 WebSocket 客户端的传入消息的执行器的统计信息。

items.source: Get stats about the executor processing outgoing messages to WebSocket clients.
items.translation: 获取有关处理发往 WebSocket 客户端的传出消息的执行器的统计信息。

items.source: Return the configured logging period frequency in milliseconds.
items.translation: 返回配置的日志记录周期频率（以毫秒为单位）。

items.source: Get stats about the SockJS task scheduler.
items.translation: 获取 SockJS 任务调度器的统计信息。

items.source: NOTE: This callback won't be triggered for singleton beans lazily initialized on demand after BeanFactory bootstrap, and not for any other bean scope either. Carefully use it for beans with the intended bootstrap semantics only.
items.translation: 注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

items.source: Description copied from interface: SmartInitializingSingleton
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：SmartInitializingSingleton

items.source:
Invoked right at the end of the singleton pre-instantiation phase,
with a guarantee that all regular singleton beans have been created
already.
items.translation: 在单例预实例化阶段的最末尾被调用，此时可以保证所有常规单例 Bean 已经创建完毕。

items.source: Get stats about STOMP broker relay (when using a full-featured STOMP broker).
items.translation: 获取 STOMP 中继代理的统计信息（在使用功能完整的 STOMP 代理时）。

items.source: Get stats about STOMP-related WebSocket message processing.
items.translation: 获取有关 STOMP 相关 WebSocket 消息处理的统计信息。

items.source: Get stats about WebSocket sessions.
items.translation: 获取 WebSocket 会话的统计信息。

items.source: Set the frequency for logging information at INFO level in milliseconds.
items.translation: 设置以毫秒为单位的日志信息记录频率（INFO 级别）。
